items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: And he was friends with Charlie Parker. I have — I’m staring across the room at my dad’s book Inside Bebop framed, and it’s autographed “To Leonard, my best friend, Charlie Parker.”

ctx.x: Yes and it’s informative to read now. What he chose to write about people back then, in the 60s, and we know them now from their whole career after that but we sometimes forget what they did when they were young men and women.

Yeah. Yeah well it’s so magical in a way, the way my dad arrived on the scene exactly when he did because everything was happening. And he was friends with Charlie Parker. I have — I’m staring across the room at my dad’s book Inside Bebop framed, and it’s autographed “To Leonard, my best friend, Charlie Parker.”
I’m not sure how to phrase this question but I’ll give it a try.
